description: Every custom record this review adds to a BDB (H) entry. A custom record shows first for every use of its entry, Tanakh and New Testament alike, so each one was checked against the entry's Old Testament uses.

records.ot_check: fits: desire and long for (Deut 12:20, Ps 132:13), wish (Prov 21:10)

records.text_en: Jezebel, infamous queen/name used for a corrupting figure.
records.text_es: Jezabel, reina infame/nombre usado para una figura corruptora.
records.ot_check: fits: Jezebel the queen of Ahab (1 Kgs 16:31); the name is used for the corrupting figure of Rev 2:20
fits: man (Gen 2:23), husband (Gen 3:6), each one (Gen 10:5)

records.text_en: Aram; Syria and Mesopotamia, the land of the Arameans; Aram the son of Shem, and other men of this name.
records.text_es: Aram; Siria y Mesopotamia, la tierra de los arameos; Aram hijo de Sem, y otros hombres de este nombre.
records.ot_check: fits: Aram as land and people (2 Sam 8:5), Aram-naharaim Mesopotamia (Gen 24:10), Aram son of Shem (Gen 10:22), and the other men named Aram (Gen 22:21, 1 Chr 7:34)

records.text_en: create; make, form; in the piel, cut down; in the hiphil, make fat.
records.text_es: crear; hacer, formar; en piel, talar; en hifil, engordar.
records.ot_check: fits: create (Gen 1:1), form (Isa 43:1); the Piel cut down (Josh 17:15) and Hiphil make fat (1 Sam 2:29) are named
fits: a gemstone of the high priest's breastplate (Exod 28:17), rendered emerald or carbuncle
fits: generation (Gen 7:1), age and period (Isa 51:9), dwelling (Isa 38:12)
fits: the still small voice (1 Kgs 19:12), stillness (Job 4:16, Ps 107:29)
fits: seek (Deut 4:29), inquire (Gen 25:22), require (Gen 9:5)
fits: be, become and come to pass are the BDB senses across the Tanakh

records.text_en: harm, destroy, act corruptly; take in pledge; be in travail.
records.text_es: dañar, destruir, actuar corruptamente; tomar en prenda; estar de parto.
records.ot_check: fits: act corruptly (Neh 1:7), destroy (Isa 13:5), take in pledge (Exod 22:25), travail (Song 8:5)

records.text_en: divide, share, distribute; be smooth, flatter.
records.text_es: dividir, compartir, repartir; ser liso, lisonjear.
records.ot_check: fits: divide and share (Gen 14:15, Josh 18:2), distribute (1 Sam 30:24); be smooth and flatter (Ps 55:21, Prov 2:16)

records.text_en: for nothing; in vain; without cause.
records.ot_check: fits: for nothing (Gen 29:15), in vain (Prov 1:17), without cause (1 Sam 19:5, Ps 35:7)

records.text_en: desire, love, be attached to; furnish with fillets.
records.text_es: desear, amar, apegarse; proveer de varillas.
records.ot_check: fits: set his love upon (Deut 7:7), desire (1 Kgs 9:19); the Piel and Pual furnish with fillets (Exod 27:17, 38:28) is named

records.text_en: Jeconiah; Jehoiachin, king of Judah taken to Babylon.
records.text_es: Jeconías; Joaquín, rey de Judá llevado a Babilonia.
records.ot_check: fits: Jeconiah, another name of Jehoiachin, king taken to Babylon (Jer 24:1, 1 Chr 3:16)
fits: the Hiphil sense of the BDB entry, lay down, set, leave behind, as in Gen 2:15 and Exod 16:33

records.text_en: Cush; the region south of Egypt (Nubia or Ethiopia), and Cush the son of Ham; also a Benjamite of this name.

records.ot_check: fits: the land of Cush south of Egypt (Isa 18:1, Esth 1:1), Cush son of Ham (Gen 10:6), and Cush the Benjamite (Ps 7:1)

records.text_en: Megiddon; Megiddo, used in the expression Har Megiddon (Armageddon).
